evidence: evidence/reference-sections.png; full section/socket/component measurements in reference-measurements.json
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

measuredSource.corroboration: Read flat_clip.scad and kit_frame.scad: flat_clip_hole(4) adds 0.25 mm per side, thickness 1.6 + 0.1 clearance; original wire tapers toward one 0.2 mm layer.

designMapping.carrier: Original Manifold CSG four-shelf rectangular carrier with 16 real low removable runners. No original cat shapes, source clips or raw meshes bundled.
designMapping.socket: Use measured 4.50 mm SOCKET span as the baseline for NEW 4.50 mm straight tongues. This is not the 4.00 mm male source clip, not its snap latch, and not an unchanged fit. Slots are (4.50+c) × (sheet+c), total c=0.10–0.30 mm; all three joints require adhesive.
designMapping.sheet: 2.2–3.0 mm redesigned sheet versus measured 1.60 mm, providing ≥1.5 mm backing under protected engraving.
designMapping.tabs: 0.8–1.2 mm wide, 0.4–0.6 mm high runners deliberately strengthen original 0.21–0.22 mm tops. Four accessible horizontal runners per part; none touches functional tongues, bores or lower contact.
designMapping.interaction: Original Prytz-style tracing experiment, not the source spacecraft or another prior kit: an 80–110 mm arm places a trailing longitudinal skid behind a pencil held by two coaxial guide bores.
designMapping.contact: One-sided 2 mm bevel narrows skid thickness to adjustable 0.8–1.2 mm at contact. No metal blade, sharpening or proven no-side-slip behavior.
designMapping.pencil: Two equal p.pencil + p.bore holes, 0.2–0.6 mm diametral clearance. Actual axial spacing = sheet + selected separation. External pencil height adjusted manually to contact plane.
designMapping.art: Exact boolean engraving of supported STL or bounded 20×20 image height field in central arm patch, radius≤6.5 mm, away from interfaces.

theory.name: Prytz hatchet planimeter / nonholonomic directional drag
theory.scope: Historical factual interaction only, original implementation. L² × net angle is only a small-loop approximation with start/finite-reach errors. No force/friction simulation or accuracy claim.

reusedInfrastructure: Generic local-only studio controls, strict parser, bounded art conversion, carrier packing, serializer and browser tests adapted from Daily Object Lab. New physical geometry, contact bevel, joints, placement and independent fit/pencil/insertion checks. Not an unchanged re-export or cosmetic mechanism reskin.
